title: Travel: John Lennon – Paris to London | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from Paris to London on 25 April 1971.

This was their return journey after having been arrested in Palma de Mallorca two days previously. They fled first to Paris, spending the night there before returning to London on this day.
